opinion.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.K.1: Name the topic/book and express an opinion or preference. The standard also permits drawing or dictation, outside this text-only implementation.
opinion.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.K.1: Use basic English grammar, common nouns/verbs, regular plurals and complete simple sentences in text.
